title: GenerateFinancialReportPayload
description: Payload for the GENERATE_FINANCIAL_REPORT intent. Requests a financial report for a period and one or more business units.

report_type.description: Closed enum of supported report kinds.

period.description: Period covered. Format depends on report_type: 'YYYY-MM' for monthly, 'YYYY-Qn' for quarterly, 'YYYY' for annual, 'YYYY-MM-DD/YYYY-MM-DD' for ad-hoc range.

business_ids.description: One or more business units to include. Empty list is rejected (must be explicit).

currency.description: Reporting currency. If not specified, books currency is used.

consolidate.description: If true and multiple business_ids are provided, return a consolidated view in addition to per-business breakdowns.

include_drafts.description: Include uncommitted/draft transactions. Off by default — drafts shouldn't appear in finalized reports.

purpose.description: Optional reason for the report. Useful for audit trail (e.g. 'board pack Q2', 'investor update').
